app_identity.name: HeatShield SG
app_identity.mission: A digital sanctuary. When it is 36°C and sweltering outside, this app must feel cool, calm, dark, and protective. It is a premium health-tech tool, not a generic weather app.
app_identity.emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Luxury. Precision, calm authority, and high-end tactility.

theme_and_vibe.background: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) to Midnight Slate (#0B0F19). This creates the ultimate contrast for the glowing heat indicators.
theme_and_vibe.surfaces: Crystal Glassmorphism. High opacity backgrounds (bg-black/60) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and a delicate 1px border (border-white/10). No muddy greys.

green_low.description: Emerald/Mint. Represents safety, cool spots, and optimal conditions.

amber_moderate.description: Rich Gold. Represents caution, stay hydrated.

red_high.description: Ruby/Crimson. Represents danger, seek shade immediately. Avoid standard harsh alarm red.

typography.heading_font: Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk. High-end, geometric, and authoritative. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers.
typography.body_font: Manrope or IBM Plex Sans. Highly legible, great for numbers and data.

copywriting_rules.jargon_free: NEVER use the term 'WBGT' or 'Heat Stress Index'.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, and gap-6. Let the data breathe.
layouts_and_grids.desktop: Bento-box grid style (grid-cols-12) with an asymmetrical layout. Sidebar navigation.
layouts_and_grids.mobile: Bottom navigation bar with a distinct, floating central 'Home/Heat' action button. Stacked cards with generous vertical rhythm.

hero_heat_orb.description: The centerpiece of the dashboard. A 3D-like, glowing orb or tactile dial representing the current heat level.
hero_heat_orb.implementation: Use Framer Motion to create a slow-breathing scale animation (1 to 1.02). Use radial gradients to simulate a 3D sphere. Drop shadow with the current heat scale color for a 'glow' effect.

forecast_chart.implementation: Use Recharts. Hide grid lines. Use a smooth curved Area chart. The area should be a gradient of the heat scale (e.g., green to amber).

cool_spot_card.style: Glass card with a background image of the location overlaid with a dark gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) to ensure text readability.

ai_chat.description: Floating or dedicated view for AI advisory.
ai_chat.style: Neumorphic message bubbles. The AI's messages should have a subtle tint of the current heat risk color.

visual_changes: Disable all glassmorphism and 3D blur effects. Use solid, high-contrast flat backgrounds (#161B26).
Change heat scale to absolute stark colors for maximum contrast.
Increase all button hit areas to minimum h-16 (64px).
Change layout from Bento Grid to a single-column stacked list.
Add explicit text labels next to all icons.

motion_and_3d.interactions: Hover tilt on desktop cards (using Framer Motion), subtle parallax on scroll.
motion_and_3d.transitions: Use spring animations for layout changes (e.g., toggling Simplified Mode).
motion_and_3d.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query. Disable hover tilts and breathing orb if true.

cooling_spot_mall.description: A bright, modern multi-level mall with indoor trees and air conditioning. Use for 'Nearest Cool Spot - Mall'.

cooling_spot_park.description: Large shaded tree in a park. Use for 'Nearest Cool Spot - Park'.

elderly_user_context.description: Elderly Asian men looking at a phone. Use for Onboarding or Caregiver context.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a hybrid mobile-first PWA and desktop dashboard. Use Tailwind's responsive prefixes (e.g., flex-col md:flex-row) to manage the layout.
All components must be written in standard Javascript React (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Remove all type annotations.
Implement a 'Simplified Mode' toggle state at the top level (e.g., React Context or top-level state) that passes a 'isSimplified' prop down to alter UI classes dynamically.
Use 'lucide-react' for all standard icons, ensuring they have an aria-label.
For the interactive Google Map, you can mock the map visually using an image or a styled div if an API key isn't provided, but structure the layout to accommodate a full bleed map container.
Use Framer Motion to animate the hero 'Heat Orb' and the transition between standard and Simplified mode.
Use Shadcn UI for standard components like Dialogs (for SOS/Emergency), Switch (for toggle), and Tabs, but override their default borders and backgrounds to match the luxury glassmorphism specs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
